# defaults: core.ignorecase=false core.precomposeunicode=false core.quotepath=false core.autocrlf=false core.symlinks=false
# source: conformance/scenarios/lines.txt

scenario lines/comment-line
kind normative
spec A line starting with # serves as a comment.
file .gitignore
| # *.log
| #another
| *.tmp
path a.log => NONE
path a.tmp => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:*.tmp
path #another => NONE

scenario lines/comment-not-at-start-is-pattern
kind normative
spec A hash that is not the first character is an ordinary character.
file .gitignore
| a #b
| c#
path a`s#b => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:a #b
path a => NONE
path c# => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:c#
path c => NONE

scenario lines/leading-space-before-hash-is-pattern
kind normative
spec Only a hash in the first column starts a comment.
file .gitignore
|  #x
path `s#x => IGNORED # .gitignore:1: #x
path #x => NONE
path x => NONE

scenario lines/blank-lines
kind normative
spec A blank line matches no files, so it can serve as a separator for readability.
file .gitignore
|
| *.log
|
|
| !keep.log
|
path a.log => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:*.log
path keep.log => INCLUDED # .gitignore:5:!keep.log
path a.txt => NONE

scenario lines/whitespace-only-line
kind normative
spec A line that contains only spaces has no pattern once trailing spaces are removed.
file .gitignore
| `s`s`s
| *.log
path a.log => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:*.log
path a.txt => NONE
path `s`s`s => NONE

scenario lines/trailing-spaces-ignored
kind normative
spec Trailing spaces are ignored unless they are quoted with backslash ("\").
file .gitignore
| foo`s`s`s
| bar/`s
| *.tmp`s
path foo => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:foo
path foo`s`s`s => NONE
path bar/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:bar/
path bar`s/ => NONE
path a.tmp => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:*.tmp
path a.tmp`s => NONE

scenario lines/escaped-trailing-space
kind normative
spec Trailing spaces are ignored unless they are quoted with backslash.
file .gitignore
| foo\`s
| bar\`s`s
path foo => NONE
path foo`s => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:foo\ 
path foo`s`s => NONE
path bar`s => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:bar\ 
path bar => NONE

scenario lines/escaped-trailing-space-with-more
kind git-quirk
spec Trailing spaces are ignored unless they are quoted with backslash.
note With several trailing spaces only the spaces after the last escaped one are removed.
file .gitignore
| a\`s`s`s
| b \`s`s
path a`s => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:a\ 
path a => NONE
path b`s`s => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:b \ 
path b`s => NONE

scenario lines/trailing-tab-is-not-trimmed
kind git-quirk
spec Only spaces are mentioned by gitignore(5) as trailing whitespace.
file .gitignore
| tabbed`t
| plain`t`s
path tabbed`t => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:tabbed`t
path tabbed => NONE
path plain`t => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:plain`t
path plain => NONE

scenario lines/no-final-newline
kind normative
spec The last line of a file is a pattern even without a terminating line feed.
file .gitignore noeol
| first
| last
path first => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:first
path last => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:last
path other => NONE

scenario lines/final-newline-present
kind normative
spec A file that ends in a line feed has no extra empty pattern.
file .gitignore
| only
path only => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:only
path other => NONE

scenario lines/crlf-line-endings
kind git-quirk
spec gitignore(5) does not describe line terminators.
note Git removes a carriage return that precedes the line feed.
file .gitignore
| first`r
| *.log`r
| !keep.log`r
| dir/`r
path first => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:first
path first`r => NONE
path a.log => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:*.log
path keep.log => INCLUDED # .gitignore:3:!keep.log
path dir/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:4:dir/
path dir => NONE

scenario lines/crlf-with-trailing-space
kind git-quirk
spec gitignore(5) does not describe line terminators.
note Git removes the carriage return first and then the trailing spaces before it.
file .gitignore
| foo `r
| bar\ `r
path foo => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:foo
path foo`s => NONE
path bar`s => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:bar\ 
path bar => NONE

scenario lines/crlf-without-final-newline
kind git-quirk
spec gitignore(5) does not describe line terminators.
note A lone carriage return at the very end of the file is not followed by a line feed.
file .gitignore noeol
| first`r
| last`r
path first => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:first
path last => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:last
path last`r => NONE

scenario lines/lone-carriage-return-inside-line
kind git-quirk
spec gitignore(5) does not describe line terminators.
note A carriage return that is not directly before a line feed belongs to the pattern.
file .gitignore
| a`rb
path a`rb => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:a`rb
path a => NONE
path b => NONE

scenario lines/bom-first-line
kind git-quirk
spec gitignore(5) does not describe byte order marks.
note Git skips a UTF-8 byte order mark at the start of an ignore file.
file .gitignore
| `uFEFFfoo
| bar
path foo => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:foo
path bar => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:bar
path `uFEFFfoo => NONE

scenario lines/bom-before-comment
kind git-quirk
spec gitignore(5) does not describe byte order marks.
note Git skips the byte order mark before deciding whether the first line is a comment.
file .gitignore
| `uFEFF#comment
| baz
path #comment => NONE
path comment => NONE
path baz => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:baz
path `uFEFF#comment => NONE

scenario lines/bom-before-negation
kind git-quirk
spec gitignore(5) does not describe byte order marks.
note Git skips the byte order mark before reading the negation prefix.
file .gitignore
| `uFEFF!foo
| bar
path foo => INCLUDED # .gitignore:1:!foo
path bar => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:bar

scenario lines/bom-in-the-middle
kind git-quirk
spec gitignore(5) does not describe byte order marks.
note Only a mark at the start of the file is skipped; elsewhere it is an ordinary character.
file .gitignore
| first
| `uFEFFsecond
path first => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:first
path second => NONE
path `uFEFFsecond => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:`uFEFFsecond

scenario lines/bom-with-crlf
kind git-quirk
spec gitignore(5) does not describe byte order marks.
file .gitignore
| `uFEFFfoo`r
| bar`r
path foo => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:foo
path bar => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:bar

scenario lines/bom-in-nested-ignore-file
kind git-quirk
spec gitignore(5) does not describe byte order marks.
file sub/.gitignore
| `uFEFFfoo
path sub/foo => IGNORED # sub/.gitignore:1:foo
path foo => NONE

scenario lines/empty-ignore-file
kind normative
spec An empty .gitignore matches nothing.
file .gitignore noeol
|
path a => NONE
path a/b => NONE
path dir/ => NONE
